text: ① A股交易时段 宇树科技在科创板开启申购，发行价格为150.80元/股； ② 16:30 欧元区8月Sentix投资者信心指数； ③ 可能发布 中国1-7月社会融资规模增量、新增人民币贷款、M2等货币供应； ④ 次日03:00 美国克利夫兰联储主席哈马克讲话； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: 1) During A-share trading hours, Unitree Robotics began its subscription on the STAR Market, with an issue price of 150.80 yuan per share. 2) At 16:30, Eurozone August Sentix investor confidence index. 3) Possible release of China's January-July social financing aggregate, new yuan loans, M2 and other monetary supply data. 4) At 03:00 the next day, speech by Cleveland Fed President Hammack. Search '见闻历' on the WeChat mini-program for more.
